brief: A wall clock with hands that turn and tell the time.

requirements.evidence: No clock movement, hands, or drive mechanism exists in the parts catalog (614 parts searched, zero clock/time/hand-movement parts) or in props (zero clock props). Hex Cluster parts are static 3D-printed plastic; the configurator only checks fit and cannot provide powered motion.
requirements.requirement: Wall clock that mounts on a wall

requirements.evidence: Same as above: nothing in the system turns under power or keeps time; any hands built from static parts would be frozen in place.
requirements.requirement: Hands that turn and tell the time

finish.summary: Declined: no clock movement or turning hands exist in Hex Cluster. The system is static 3D-printed parts plus display props, so a clock whose hands actually turn and keep time cannot be built here. A static decorative clock face could be built (hex body with fixed imitation hands), but it would not turn or tell time. Place nothing.
